tei:div.tei:p: sgam po'i gtor bsngos bzhugs so/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta sogs brjod/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i gtor ma dngas shing thogs pa med pa zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can bskyed par gyur/ oṃ a ka ros byin gyis brlabs/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bsngo zhing 'bul ba'i gnas su gyur pa ni/ lha chen po dwags lha sgam po/ yab bzang po 'o de gung rgyal/ yum bzang mo thang lha'i klu mo/ mched chen po yar lha sham po/ lcam kong btsun de mo/ gcung chos lha sgam po/ gnyer pa chen po dhe wa dpal/ gzhu brdung la sogs pa ru 'dren kyi skyes bu brgya/ stag gzig dom dred la sogs pa gcan gzan gyi ru 'dren brgya/ bya khra la sogs pa 'dab chags kyi ru 'dren brgya/ gzhan yang gter bdag jo bo rgyal lha/ gnyer pa mchim lha spun bdun/ dregs pa lha srin sde brgyad/ steng lha yi dmag tshogs/ 'og klu yi dmag tshogs/ bar btsan gyi dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul lo/ bzhes nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ bla ma dam pa'i sku tshe srings/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la sdang bar byed pa'i dgra sod/ gnod par byed pa'i bgegs thul/ bar du gcod pa'i rkyen zlog /bsam pa'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i phrin las dang bka' sdod sdong grogs rgya chen po mdzad du gsol/ na mo/ bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dag dang*// de bzhin gshegs pa'i sbyin stobs dang*// chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis// 'phags pa rnams la mchod pa dang*// sems can rnams la phan gdags slad// don rnams gang dag bsam pa kun// de dag thams cad ci rigs pa// gter bdag rnams la 'dod yon tshogs// thogs pa med par 'byung gyur cig

/gter srung sgam po lha rtse'i bstod bskul ni/ kyai/ chos dbyings rnam dag nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor nas// rten 'brel rnam dag gling bzhi ri rab gsal// theg chen chos dar lho rgyal 'dzam bu gling*// nang gi gnas mchog nyi shu rtsa bzhi nas// rtswa ri zhes bya ye shes dkyil 'khor 'dir// gsang sngags lha tshogs nam mkha'i sprin ltar gtibs// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bar snang glog ltar 'khyug /bstan pa'i las mdzad zhing skyong rgyal po khyod// sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po srung ba'i tshe// kun dga' gzhon nu gnas chen bzhi na bzhugs// dam nyams dgra bo'i srog rtsa nyul ba'i tshe// lha btsan nag po bar snang khams su rgyug /dkar po lha yi rgyal srid skyong ba'i tshe// sgam po lha rtse lha dmag 'bum gyis bskor// sku mdog dkar po chu shel dngas pa'i mdog /zhal gcig phyag gnyis rab mdzes gzhon tshul can// rin chen sna lnga'i rgyan cha si li li// lha rdzas dar gyi na bza' lhubs se lhub// phyag g.yas ru dar dkar po nam mkhar phyar// sangs rgyas bstan pa mi nub rgyal mtshan 'dzin// g.yon pas gser gzhong rin chen du mas bkang*// sgrub pa po la dngos grub char ltar 'bebs// chibs su gyi ling ngang dkar khyung gshog chibs// 'khor du dam can lha dmag 'bum gyis bskor// la las drag po'i bswo sgra di ri ri// la las dpal gyi ru mtshon lhubs se lhub// lha dbang chen po dpon g.yog 'khor dang bcas// dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// dam bca' bzhin du bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod// ces phrin las bcol lo/ zab chos zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol gyi rin chen gter gyi srung ma sgam po lha rtse btsan rgod chen pos shog ser gter ston rin po che la phul skabs gter ston nyid kyis sbyar ba'o/
